gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: There's no point ___ about it now.
gaps.explanation: there's no point + -ing: no point worrying.

gaps.sentence: I can't wait ___ you the photos.
gaps.explanation: can't wait + to-infinitive: can't wait to show.

gaps.sentence: She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).

gaps.sentence: They don't allow ___ in the museum.
gaps.hint: allow + noun / allow sb to do
gaps.explanation: allow + noun/-ing (no personal object): they don't allow photography. With a person: allow visitors to photograph.

gaps.sentence: He suggested ___ a taxi instead of walking.
gaps.explanation: suggest + -ing (no infinitive with a person: suggest that we take is also possible).

gaps.sentence: The teacher advised us ___ the essay twice.
gaps.explanation: advise + object + to-infinitive: advised us to check. (advise + -ing is possible without object: advise checking.)

gaps.sentence: He denied ___ the money, but nobody believed him.
